content:
few	dared	to	cross	the	cursed	spot,	and	none	dared	to	dive
into	 the	 shivering	 water	 or	 recover	 the	 precious	 stones
that	fell	from	his	rotting	carcase.
But	 all	 the	 men	 of	 arms	 who	 were	 still	 able,	 and	 the
most	of	the	Elvenking’s	array,	got	ready	to	march	north	to
the	 Mountain.	 It	 was	 thus	 that	 in	 eleven	 days	 from	 the
ruin	 of	 the	 town	 the	 head	 of	 their	 host	 passed	 the	 rock-
gates	 at	 the	 end	 of	 the	 lake	 and	 came	 into	 the	 desolate
lands.

metadata.title: The Hobbit: Or There and Back Again
metadata.author: J. R. R. Tolkien
